summary: LORÉ v5 batch backend testing: 98/99 pass (78 prior regression all green + 20/21 new v5 tests). One CRITICAL backend bug found: PUT/GET /api/characters/{cid}/settings only persists/returns active_persona_id and silently drops all new chat-customization fields (background_path, background_blur, background_dim, user_bubble_color, char_bubble_color, font_size, glow_enabled, typing_style, animation_speed). Models accept them but the DB write/read code is unchanged from v4.

critical.issue: ChatSettingsInput model accepts background_path/background_blur/background_dim/user_bubble_color/char_bubble_color/font_size/glow_enabled/typing_style/animation_speed, but server.py:977-995 only writes 'active_persona_id' to db.chat_settings and server.py:968-974 only returns 'active_persona_id'. All 9 customization fields are silently dropped — the per-chat customization feature is non-functional on the backend.

minor.issue: Owner-only (line 502-506 uses {user_id: user.id} not _character_view). Non-owners cannot directly fetch a public character's full data via this endpoint — they must use /discover or chat sub-routes. Consider switching to _character_view for consistency with /messages, /memories, /restart, /chat. Not a blocker since /discover and /discover/featured return full Character objects.
DeprecationWarning: @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') deprecated — switch to lifespan handlers (cosmetic, not breaking).

action_items: (CRITICAL) Update set_chat_settings (server.py:977-995) to write all ChatSettingsInput fields to db.chat_settings (use {k:v for k,v in body.model_dump().items() if v is not None}). Update get_chat_settings (server.py:968-974) to return the full stored settings doc, defaulting missing fields. Without this fix, the entire per-chat Customize panel (background, blur, dim, bubble colors, font, glow, typing style, animation speed) is dead UI — values appear to save but never round-trip.
(LOW) Consider letting GET /characters/{cid} use _character_view so non-owners can fetch full Character schema (currently 404 unless they use /discover).
(LOW) Migrate FastAPI on_event to lifespan handlers.
critical_code_review_comments: set_chat_settings ignores 9 of 10 fields in ChatSettingsInput — silent data loss is the worst kind of bug because frontend will appear to work; users will think their preferences saved.
Auto-username generation in signup() is correct: lowercased local-part with non-[a-z0-9_] stripped, truncated to 20, deduped via numeric suffix. Confirmed via test_signup_dedupes_username.

/api/users/{username} correctly excludes _id, password_hash, email, settings; returns user + public_characters + public_voices. 404 on missing user. No auth required (intentional public endpoint) — verified.
PUT /api/users/me correctly enforces username uniqueness via {id: {$ne}} check (returns 400 'Username taken'). Returns fresh doc with _id and password_hash projected out.

DELETE /characters/{cid}/messages, POST /characters/{cid}/restart, DELETE /characters/{cid}/chat all use _character_view (allow public char chat) — non-owners can clear/restart/delete their own chats with public characters without affecting the character itself. Verified.
POST /characters/{cid}/memories + PATCH /memories/{mid} round-trip type/content/pinned correctly. Cross-user PATCH returns 404 (security verified).
Asset gating: private_jet correctly rejected unless finance.luxury_level == 'very_wealthy' (tested all three transitions: no-finance→400, wealthy→400, very_wealthy→200).
/findlove/candidates correctly excludes own characters via {user_id: {$ne}}; like action returns matched:true; pass returns matched:false.
/discover/featured caps at 20, sorts by updated_at desc, returns only is_public=true.
Social posts cascade-delete on profile delete (verified via empty post list after profile DELETE).
Server.py at 1493 lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers/ modules (auth, files, characters, chat, persona, memory, voices, social, world) before next iteration.

rca of the issue: RCA for chat-settings bug: ChatSettingsInput Pydantic model was extended in v5 (server.py:275-285) to accept 9 new customization fields, but the persistence handler set_chat_settings (server.py:977-995) was not updated — its $set body still hardcodes only {user_id, character_id, active_persona_id, updated_at}. Repro: PUT /api/characters/{cid}/settings with any of the new fields; 200 OK; GET /api/characters/{cid}/settings returns {active_persona_id: ...} only — extra fields gone. Mitigation (one-line fix): replace the hardcoded $set with $set: {user_id, character_id, **{k:v for k,v in body.model_dump().items() if v is not None}, updated_at}, and update get_chat_settings to return the full doc minus _id (defaulting active_persona_id to None).
